card.$description: Tokens for Card: a surface that groups related content (decision 47). Measured from the audit's captures: AcmeCo's lnc-card on the broker page (desktop 1700px, phone 400px) and the outlined boxes on the property detail page (F26.4).

background.$description: OBSERVED: white (#ffffff) behind the broker page's cards; transparent on the property page's outlined boxes, which sit on white. White for both.

border.$description: OBSERVED: 1px #e5e5e5 on the property page (F26.4), 1px #eeeeee on the broker page; one border grey now (#e5e5e5). Decorative: the content carries the meaning.

radius.$description: OBSERVED: 8px on the property page, 4px on the broker page; became 8px for both, the system's surface radius (decision 26).

shadow.$description: OBSERVED: the broker page's cards float on a soft shadow (rgba(119,119,119,0.07) 0 2px 22px 10px), a second card shadow beside the property card's; became the one card shadow (decision 11), used by the raised appearance only.

gap.$description: OBSERVED: 12.8px under the card's heading (Bio); became 12px between the heading, the content and the actions.

outline.$description: OBSERVED: 16px inside the property page's outlined boxes (F26.4).

raised.$description: OBSERVED: 30px inside the broker page's cards at 1700px; became 32px (the 4px grid).

raised-phone.$description: OBSERVED: 20px inside the broker page's cards on the phone; became 16px, the page gutter, so text keeps its width at 375px.
